content.title: About
content.content: Fruit juice blend is a 100 % natural juice made from a mix of apples, pears, oranges and berries. The juice contains no added sugar, preservatives or artificial flavors. It offers a bright fruit taste and is rich in B‑vitamins, vitamin C and antioxidants.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The juice is produced by cold‑press extraction, preserving most of the nutrients.
The fruit blend is selected to achieve an optimal balance of sweetness and acidity.
Demand for 100 % juices grew by more than 15 % in Russia during the 2020s.
The juice can be used as a base for smoothies, cocktails and marinades.
Packaging is made from recyclable PET, reducing the product’s carbon footprint.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, aids collagen synthesis and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports normal heart function.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: 100 ml of juice provides about 45 kcal, making it a light snack option.

items.title: Source of flavonoids
items.content: Flavonoids from berries and citrus have anti‑inflammatory and antioxidant effects.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The juice is mostly water, helping to maintain the body’s hydration status.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to oranges or other citrus fruits in the blend.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, natural fruit sugars can raise blood glucose levels in people with diabetes.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or reflux.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drink the juice chilled, use it as a base for smoothies, cocktails, fruit salads, or in cooking recipes as a water substitute.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 2‑6 °C. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Do not keep above 10 °C to prevent spoilage.
